title: Evidence audit: a synthetic wearable pipeline
promptMarkdown: Audit this explicitly synthetic study. One hundred volunteers each contribute20 windows, with a binary target for a future event. Investigators randomly split windows70/15/15%, normalise all2000 windows together, add a feature computed from a clinician note written after the event, try40 architectures and five thresholds on the named test split, choose the best test accuracy of94%, report only the best of ten training seeds, and compare with a50% random baseline although90% of cases are negative. They deploy on a later clinic and call94% “proven accuracy for new patients”. Write a corrected protocol and specify what evidence remains usable. Include entity/time leakage, preprocessing, outcome leakage, selection, baseline, uncertainty, checkpoint policy and deployment population. Provide a concise prediction that a clean follow-up could falsify.
hintLadder: For each feature ask: could it exist at the actual prediction time?
For every selection decision ask which data influenced it.
A useful corrected protocol names the independent unit, baseline and target population.
Distinguish reusable engineering work from invalidated performance evidence.
